description: Which chain each chain source must describe, and which existing Undrly instrument each issuer address list is about (docs/v1.5-solana.md). No address or mint is stated here: those come only from the issuer's own published list, stored raw first. Reviewed 2026-09-28 (Robinhood Chain added in V1.6; Tempo and pathUSD in V1.7; BNB Smart Chain in V1.10). TIP-20 assets are bound by protocol-constant addresses and verified against the chain.

chains.name: Solana
chains.authority: The cluster's own getGenesisHash (Solana docs: https://solana.com/docs/references/clusters, https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getgenesishash); CAIP-2 Solana profile: the genesis hash truncated to 32 characters (https://github.com/ChainAgnostic/namespaces/blob/main/solana/caip2.md). A response for any other cluster is rejected.

chains.name: Robinhood Chain
chains.authority: The chain's own eth_chainId (0x1237 = 4663) at its public mainnet RPC; Robinhood Chain docs publish chain ID 4663 for mainnet and 46630 for testnet (https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting/). CAIP-2 eip155 reference = EIP-155 chain id. Any other chain id is rejected.

chains.name: Tempo
chains.authority: The chain's own eth_chainId (0x1079 = 4217) at its public mainnet RPC; Tempo docs: 'Tempo Mainnet has been live since March 18, 2026 ... chain ID 4217'; Moderato testnet is 42431 (https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/quickstart/connection-details). Any other chain id is rejected.

chains.name: BNB Smart Chain
chains.authority: The chain's own eth_chainId (0x38 = 56) at BNB Chain's public mainnet RPC (docs.bnbchain.org: JSON-RPC endpoints; chain ID 56). CAIP-2 eip155 reference = EIP-155 chain id. Any other chain id is rejected. Added in V1.10 for Binance bStocks.

issuers.authority: Circle issues USDC; its developer documentation lists the USDC contract address on every supported mainnet. Only the `## Mainnet` table is read.

tip20Assets.authority: pathUSD is a TIP-20 predeployed at genesis at a protocol-constant address (Tempo docs: Predeployed contracts; pathUSD on Tempo Mainnet and quote tokens). The chain is asked for chain id, name, symbol, currency and decimals in one batch; any mismatch with this entry rejects the record. currency() is TIP-20's immutable reference-asset declaration ('the reference asset that 1 unit of the token is designed to be worth'). The issuer is not bound: Tempo names 'Bridge', but no Bridge source confirms pathUSD or its legal entity (docs/v1.7-tempo.md §8).
